howItWorks.title: How It Works
items: Every build starts once we receive your logo, content and images.
Delivery times are in business days and begin after content handoff.
Revision rounds cover the same page or section — not new features.
Care-plan hours reset each month; unused time doesn't carry over.
Monthly plans require a minimum 6-month commitment.
Extra hours are billed at $10/hr for care-plan clients.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common Questions
faq.q1p1: The website build price does not include domain or hosting — these are paid separately.
faq.q1p2: But once you add a Monthly Care Plan, web hosting is included in your monthly price. You'll only pay separately for your domain name (typically $10–15/year).
faq.q1s2b: — hosting included in your monthly fee
faq.q2: Can I cancel the care plan anytime?
faq.q2a: Care plans require a minimum 6-month commitment. After that, you can cancel anytime with 30 days' notice. There are no long-term contracts beyond that.
faq.q3: Do I need to provide content for my website?
faq.q3a: Yes — you provide your logo, text (business description, services, contact details) and any photos. Build delivery begins once we receive your content, and we'll guide you on what to prepare.
faq.q4: What if I need changes outside my care-plan hours?
faq.q4a: Extra work beyond your monthly hours is billed at $10/hr. New pages, full redesigns or new features are quoted as separate projects, and we always confirm the cost before starting.
